command:
set -euo pipefail; python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path("docs/SANDBOX_EXECUTION_FLOW.md"); s=p.read_text(); old="Status: **ACTIVE during stability recovery**  
Canonical product/recovery plan: `docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md`"; new="Status: **ACTIVE engineering workflow**  
Canonical documentation entry point: `docs/README.md`  
Current active plan: `docs/UI_UX_REDESIGN_PLAN.md`"; assert old in s; p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1)); p=Path("MVP_GOAL_PROMPT.md"); s=p.read_text(); old="> **Historical execution plan.** During the stability feature freeze, do not execute this checklist in order. `docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md` is authoritative, and `docs/STABLE_CORE_PREIMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md` defines the current Phase 1 implementation boundary."; new="> **Historical execution plan.** Do not execute this checklist as current work. Phase 3 is closed; current project status and the active plan start at `docs/README.md` and `docs/UI_UX_REDESIGN_PLAN.md`."; assert old in s; p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1)); p=Path("docs/STABLE_CORE_PREIMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md"); s=p.read_text(); banner="> **HISTORICAL STATUS NOTICE:** This Phase 1 audit is retained as stabilization provenance. Phase 3 is now ACCEPTED / CLOSED; current work starts from `docs/README.md` and the active plan named there.

"; p.write_text(s if s.startswith(banner) else banner+s)'; git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- docs/SANDBOX_EXECUTION_FLOW.md MVP_GOAL_PROMPT.md docs/STABLE_CORE_PREIMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md
